title: dryopteris yabei var. hololepis
intro: Dryopteris yabei var. hololepis, commonly known as Japanese Shield Fern, is a type of plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as therapeutic actions like reducing fever and relieving pain. The bioactive constituents of Japanese Shield Fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
